item.guhs.koh_spawn_egg: Koh the Face Stealer Spawn Egg
Welcome, little guh. What an... interesting little face you have. Do stay very, very calm.
I already have a thousand faces, nyeg. One more would look so... chonky on me.
*sniffs your hand* ...Do you smell a little like Nibble Chorus? My forest has smelled of ash for so long.
Shhh. Do you hear the forest whisper? It's whispering your name. ...No, just kidding. It's whispering 'nibble'.
Grrrum. Roku Guh and I flew above the clouds every morning. Mostly I miss the breakfast afterwards.
A spirit dragon flies wherever his heart wants to go. My heart mostly wants to go to the tea pavilion, nyeg.
We have swum in circles for ages. Push and pull, light and dark, Tui and La. Dizzy? Never.
No tides without the moon, no moon without the ocean. ...And no guhs without nibbles.
*sniffs your nose and zooms off* ...*comes back* ...*zooms off again*
I'm a little lost. But as long as I'm lit, I'm never completely in the dark, nyeg!
*winks* A lantern that winks? In the Spirit World that's perfectly normal, you know.
Shhh... go away. This is my dark little edge. I only push a little. *push*
I was once a thought nobody wanted to think. Now I push guhs aside. Nice career, nyeg.
I came here once for a single cup of tea. That was three hundred years ago. The tea is still delightful.
I know someone who will want to live here one day... round, a beard, says wise things about tea. I'm keeping a cushion free for him.
One order? Coming right up! *runs to the bank* ...Want a receipt with that, nyeg?
Just tell me what you need: I'll fetch it all from your bank and set the machines running. Fast, cheerful and chonky!
